svg.title: SkyHarbor Global Executive Shift and Gate Map
svg.desc: Gated trajectory diagram showing plausible modernization shifts across four swim lanes: Architecture Platform, Sourcing and Vendor, Data and Analytics, and AI Governance. Each lane shows current-state constraints, gate conditions, and directional next-state positions. No target-state commitment is asserted. Planning-grade confidence. Synthetic demo dataset.
